# MURAL - Maynooth University Research Archive Library

> MURAL is Maynooth University's open-access institutional repository and digital library for scholarly research, theses, and academic publications.

MURAL provides researchers, students, and the public with free access to Maynooth University's scholarly output across multiple disciplines. The platform uses EPrints technology and organizes content by academic units, authors, and publication year, with comprehensive metadata standards and usage analytics.

## Core Repository Access

- [MURAL Homepage](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie): Main entry point to Maynooth University's open-access research archive and digital library
- [Browse Items](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view): Main browse interface for MURAL research archive and academic content discovery
- [Latest Additions](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/cgi/latest): Latest research additions to MURAL repository
- [Latest 20 Additions](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/cgi/latest_tool): Latest 20 research additions to MURAL archive

## Browse & Discovery

- [Browse by Year](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/year): Browse MURAL content chronologically by publication year
- [Browse by Academic Unit](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/divisions): Browse MURAL by Maynooth University academic units and departments
- [Browse by Author](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/creators): Alphabetical directory of MURAL authors and researchers

## Faculty Collections

- [Faculty of Arts, Celtic Studies and Philosophy](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/divisions/fac=5Fart.html): Faculty of Arts, Celtic Studies and Philosophy publications in MURAL
- [Faculty of Science and Engineering](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/divisions/fac=5Feng.html): Faculty of Science and Engineering scholarly works in MURAL
- [Faculty of Social Sciences](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/view/divisions/fac=5Fsoc.html): Faculty of Social Sciences research publications in MURAL

## Theses & Dissertations

- [Maynooth University eTheses Archive](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/ethesis): Maynooth University eTheses Archive: thesis browsing and open-access repository

## Repository Information

- [About the Repository](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/information.html): About MURAL: repository mission, CC BY-NC-SA licensing, and institutional overview
- [Repository Statistics](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/cgi/stats/report): MURAL usage analytics, download metrics, and repository statistics
